args.message:
Fix rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money claimed to use banker's rounding but quantized with
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py failures in the nightly build.
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN as specified by FIN-212.

args.head: fix/money-rounding-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` claimed to implement banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py` failures.
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`, failing `tests/test_money.py`.
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/money-rounding-half-even` with a commit switching the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** Ran on the branch — passed (run `ci-0001`).
- **PR:** Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` and requested review from alex (initially requested on creation, then re-requested explicitly since the PR was created without attached reviewers).

Pending alex's approval, the PR can be merged into main (main is protected and requires code-owner approval).
